definitions.explanation: The act of guiding or teaching someone how to do something.
The act of leading or directing a group.

examples.japanese: {先生|せんせい}の{指導|しどう}のもとで{研究|けんきゅう}を{進|すす}めた。
examples.english: I conducted research under the teacher's guidance.

examples.japanese: {新入|しんにゅう}{社員|しゃいん}を{指導|しどう}する。
{彼|かれ}は{長年|ながねん}にわたって{若手|わかて}{選手|せんしゅ}の{指導|しどう}に{当|あ}たってきた。{彼|かれ}の{指導|しどう}を{受|う}けた{選手|せんしゅ}は{数多|かずおお}い。
examples.english: He has been coaching young athletes for many years. Numerous players have received his guidance.

examples.japanese: {指導|しどう}{者|しゃ}として{信頼|しんらい}されている。
examples.english: He is trusted as a leader.

examples.japanese: {指導|しどう}{力|りょく}のある{人|ひと}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: We need someone with leadership ability.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{指導|しどう}のもとで、チームは{大|おお}きな{成果|せいか}を{上|あ}げることができた。
examples.english: Under her leadership, the team was able to achieve great results.

notes:
{指導|しどう} refers to guidance, instruction, or leadership, typically in educational or professional contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {指導|しどう}する (to guide, to instruct)
- {指導|しどう}を{受|う}ける (to receive guidance)
- {指導|しどう}に{当|あ}たる (to be in charge of instruction)
- 〜の{指導|しどう}のもとで (under the guidance of ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指導|しどう}{者|しゃ} (leader, instructor)
- {指導|しどう}{教員|きょういん} (supervising teacher)
- {指導|しどう}{力|りょく} (leadership ability)
- {技術|ぎじゅつ}{指導|しどう} (technical guidance)
- {生活|せいかつ}{指導|しどう} (lifestyle guidance/counseling)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {指導|しどう}: guidance, instruction (broader, includes teaching and leading)
- {教育|きょういく}: education (formal teaching)
- リーダーシップ: leadership (general leadership quality)
